Class ScheduleDAO

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.db.ScheduleDAO
public class ScheduleDAO extends Object
Reads and writes the user's workout schedule.

Dates and times are stored in ISO form (2026-09-20, 18:00) so they sort and compare correctly in SQL, and duration is stored as an integer number of minutes rather than as the string "45 mins".

US-10, US-22, US-32.

    • save

      public ScheduledWorkout save(String username, ScheduledWorkout workout)
      Saves a new workout for the given user.
      Parameters:
      username - the user the workout belongs to
      workout - the workout to schedule
      Returns:
      the same workout carrying the id the database assigned, or the original unsaved instance if the insert failed

    • findForUser

      public List<ScheduledWorkout> findForUser(String username)
      Every scheduled workout belonging to this user, soonest first.

      Rows written before dates were stored in ISO form are read with ScheduleValidator.parseDate(String); anything still unreadable is skipped rather than crashing the screen.

      Parameters:
      username - the user whose schedule to load
      Returns:
      the user's scheduled workouts, or an empty list if none or if loading fails

    • updateReminderLead

      public void updateReminderLead(int id, int reminderLeadMinutes)
      Changes how far ahead the user is reminded, or switches the reminder off with 0.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the scheduled workout
      reminderLeadMinutes - minutes before the start time to remind; 0 turns it off
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id or minutes are invalid, or the workout no longer exists
      IllegalStateException - if the reminder cannot be saved

    • deleteAllForUser

      public void deleteAllForUser(String username)
      Removes every scheduled workout belonging to this user, for the Settings page's "Clear All Data". Other users' schedules and the account itself are untouched. An unknown username matches nothing, so it is a harmless no-op.
      Parameters:
      username - the user whose schedule to clear
